description.en: Systematic assessment of large non-pedunculated colorectal polyps for size, morphology (Paris classification), site, access, surface and vascular pattern (NICE/JNET), and features predicting submucosal invasion.

criteria.en: Identifies LNPCPs and applies Paris classification with prompting.
Independently records SMSA, Paris morphology, NICE/JNET pattern, flags SMI features. Decision-aligned with senior ≥90% of cases.
Teaches lesion assessment; pre-resection histology prediction high accuracy; recognises atypical lesions warranting alternative management.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of source-canonical ESGE EMR recommendations into trainee-assessable units. The recommendation is what ESGE publishes; the competency is what Evideris uses to score a trainee on. Not enumerated as objects in Tate EMR 2023; this competency frame is Evideris's design.
